_: The reasons the record gives: why a people fell or ended, why it left a star or came to rest, why a war began and how it ended, what a blast was, what a people became. The simulation stores the key; the view renders the text with the ids beside it: {C} the people named (by), {O} the other side, {T} the star (at), {P} the plague, {B} the blast, {L} the remain, {filter} the filter's name.

causes: what a fact's cause or why is, keyed; the text follows 'They' for an ending, a fall or a dark age, and stands alone for a leaving, a resting, a cut-off or a peace. blasts: what a blast event was, by its way. becomings: what a transformed people became (Civ.Into). war_causes and war_results: why a war was declared and how it ended. betrayals: the shape of a broken faith.
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.
